name: Minecraft
what: Dig, build and survive in a world made of blocks.

fanProjects.name: Luanti + VoxeLibre
fanProjects.what: Luanti (it used to be called Minetest) is a free block game engine. Add the free VoxeLibre game for a very similar feel.
howToPlay: Open it, click "Content", then "Browse online content".
Install VoxeLibre (or Mineclonia), then start a new world with it.

scopeNote: A full block world is an epic job. Start with one small island you can dig and build on.
legalNote: Don't use Minecraft's name, block pictures, creatures (like Creepers) or sounds. Make your own.
